completeness_critic:
Verified the evidence surfaces on disk. Here is the completeness critique.

---

## (1) Dimensions where the evidence is thin / claim-based → re-run warranted

**oneshot (6.7) — RE-RUN.** The only *runnable* one-shot/autonomy proof is `.claude/workflows/walteur-run.mjs`, whose own honesty header states: "NOT a real autonomous build… every `agent()` call here is STUBBED… NO model runs, NO product code is written." Meanwhile every ledger row in `field-runs/SHIPPED.md` self-labels autonomy as `harness-orchestrated + hand-verified` or `harness-assisted` — none says `fully-autonomous`. A 6.7 for "one-shot" credits autonomy the artifacts do not verify. Re-run to pin the score to what the ledger actually proves (harness-assisted), not to the stub runner.

**orchestration (7.8) — SPOT RE-CHECK.** Same root: the standalone runnable proof of the orchestrator's telemetry path is the same stub. The honesty framing is strong (verbatim `emitSpan`/`flushSpans` extraction is real), so the score may hold, but confirm it is scored from real `run-trace.jsonl` rows on real field-runs, not from the stub's canned spans.

**design (5.7) — thin but correctly low; do NOT re-run, ship instead.** The design gates exist and are rigorous (`walteur-kit/hooks/{apple-grade-design-gate,browser-proof-gate,design-depth-gate,anti-slop-ui}.sh`) but have essentially never been fired against a real UI: no populated `browser-proof.json` anywhere in `field-runs/` (only a lone `browser-proof.schema.json` under `support-risk-command-center`), no screenshots in any field-run, zero framework UI (every "UI" ship is vanilla `.html`, no `.tsx/.jsx/.vue/.svelte`), and only one stray `apple-grade-report.json`. 5.7 is a defensible score for "gates present, field-proof absent" — the fix is a ship, not a re-score.

qa (7.8), reliability (7.4), memory, code, security are backed by on-disk `*-report.json`, `execution-ratio-report.json`, and real `node --test` counts — well-cited, not thin.

---

## (2) The single most load-bearing gap blocking 98/100 (none < 9.0)

**The harness has never field-proven a real, visually-audited, publicly-reachable UI product.** Every row in `field-runs/SHIPPED.md` is a headless/backend API or a client-side dashboard served on `localhost` and explicitly marked "NOT public, no external URL." This one gap caps the three lowest ceilings simultaneously: it is *why* design is 5.7 (no browser-proof, no screenshots, no framework UI to exercise the Apple-grade gates), it drags oneshot (no fully-autonomous end-to-end ship to point at), and it holds down the credibility of reliability/docs. No amount of hook editing lifts design past ~7; only a verified UI ship — a real `browser-proof.json` + screenshots + a11y evidence + a third-party-openable URL — moves design to 9.0 and unlocks the 98.

---

## (3) File-scoped backlog, ranked by weighted-score lift

1. **[EXTERNAL SHIP]** Build and deploy one real framework UI product (Vite/React) to a public URL, then add a `verified` row to `/…/Pro Coding/field-runs/SHIPPED.md` with a populated `browser-proof.json` + screenshots + a11y evidence. Single biggest lever: design 5.7→9+, plus oneshot/reliability/docs credibility. Nothing else clears the <9.0 floor.

2. **[EXTERNAL SHIP → then NON-gated]** Create `/…/Pro Coding/field-runs/<ui-app>/` containing a genuine framework UI, run `walteur-kit/hooks/browser-proof-gate.sh` + `apple-grade-design-gate.sh` against it, and commit the resulting `walteur-kit/browser-proof.json` + `apple-grade-report.json`. Even a local (not-public) framework UI with real proofs partially exercises the design stack that is currently untested end-to-end.

3. **[GATED]** `.claude/workflows/walteur-run.mjs` — the autonomy proof is a self-declared stub. Add a minimal *real* end-to-end smoke build (one tiny task where `agent()` actually runs and writes+tests real code) so oneshot/orchestration have a non-stub artifact. Touches the orchestrator path → human-gate per the self-modification rule.

4. **[NON-gated]** `/…/Pro Coding/walteur-kit/hooks/design-gate.sh` — today it passes on any `DESIGN.md` with ≥10 lines + one color; it cannot tell a real design system from a stub-plus-color. Cross-link it: for a UI build, require a matching non-empty `browser-proof.json`, so a `DESIGN.md` with no visual proof fails. Closes the "contract exists, screen never rendered" loophole.

5. **[NON-gated]** `/…/Pro Coding/field-runs/SHIPPED.md` — every row is `localhost`/"NOT public." Once item 1 exists, record at least one row whose URL a skeptic can open; the ledger's own honesty contract discounts `attested`/local rows, so this directly converts discounted credit into full credit for the field-proven dimensions.

6. **[NON-gated]** `/…/Pro Coding/.github/workflows/ci.yml` — add a job that runs the design gate suite (`browser-proof-gate`, `apple-grade-design-gate`, `anti-slop-ui`) against the UI field-run from item 2, so design evidence is continuously re-verified rather than a one-time claim. Makes the design lift durable across cycles.

**Sequencing:** items 1→5→2→6 are the design/oneshot spine (external ship is unavoidable and gates the ceiling); items 3–4 are the two engine-side reinforcements, with 3 requiring a human gate and 4 freely reachable.
